13.3.2 Backend package
For an OEM backend to understand packages contents from several package
suppliers, a backend package format is proposed as described in below picture:
Figure 13-2 Overview Backend Package
The software package format is vendor-specific. However, as the backend package
is meant to be vendor-independent, Software Package Manifest (in red Figure 13-2)
must use the ARXML file format.
